title: Shark Cage Diving & Surface Viewing- Gansbaai
summary: Shark cage diving and surface viewing from a boat out of Gansbaai. No scuba diving experience is needed and all ages are welcome.
description:
Dispel those myths and fears and go Shark Cage Diving Today!

Experience their true magnificence with an up close and personal encounter with sharks. The viewing decks onboard the boat offer spectacular surface viewing with cage diving as optional.

No scuba diving experience is needed. All ages are welcome, young and old.

Sharks you may encounter: Copper Sharks, Sevengill Cow Sharks, and the rare Great White Shark.
Tour Duration: approx. 4 hrs. (depending on shark activity/sea conditions. Excludes 2.5 - 3hr. travel time)

Tour Includes:
Breakfast or lunch on arrival
Shark cage diving & surface viewing
Drinks and snacks on the boat
Use of the dive gear
A warm meal on return to shore

Please remember we are dealing with wildlife and shark sightings can never be guaranteed.

Time slots may vary according to sea/tidal & weather conditions and the number of trips we can run on the day.

Your tour details and exact meeting/collection time will be confirmed the day before.

Don't forget to bring:
Something warm to wear (fleece or a wind-proof jacket)
Comfortable shoes
Swimming trunks/bathing suit (wear underneath your clothes)
Towel
Hat, sunglasses & sunscreen
Camera
Seasickness or motion sickness tablets if appropriate (consult a pharmacy, we are not authorized to dispense any medication)

Bookings close 48 hours before time of tour. For last minute booking inquiries please email us on: info@sharkdiving.co

Or Contact us on: WhatsApp +27 82 403 0333

T&C’s apply?
profile: A boat trip out of Gansbaai to see sharks up close, with surface viewing from the deck and optional cage diving. The tour takes about four hours and includes a meal on arrival, drinks and snacks on the boat, dive gear and a warm meal back on shore. No diving experience is needed, and it suits all ages.

title: Most Influential Icons Gala Dinner 2026
summary: An annual gala that honours individuals and organisations whose leadership, service, innovation and dedication have made a meaningful impact within their communities.
description:
Most Influential Icons Gala (MIIGD) is an annual celebration that honours individuals and organisations whose leadership, service, innovation, and dedication have made a meaningful impact within their communities and beyond. The gala recognises icons from diverse sectors, including business, education, arts and culture, community development, youth empowerment, sports, health, and public service.

More than an awards event, the Most Influential Icons Gala is a platform for inspiration, networking, and collaboration. Through keynote addresses, powerful performances, and the recognition of outstanding changemakers, the evening encourages others to lead with purpose.

title: Ubumnandi Festival Seventh Annual Summer Picnic
summary: Ubumnandi Festival is a dance music festival started in Hermanus, giving youth in music, photography, videography, design and other art codes a stage in front of a big crowd.
description:
Ubumnandi Festival is a Dance Music Festival started in Hermanus in the Overstrand Region of the Western Cape in South Africa founded by Master Blaq Entertainment (PTY) LTD Trading as Blue Sky South Africa.

This high-profile Festival provides an opportunity for youth in different art codes to showcase their talent and skills for a big crowd of people and supporters from all over the country. The applicable art codes at this present moment are Music, Photography, Videography, Graphic Designs, Entrepreneurship, Drawing, Local Market etc.

title: Hermanus Carols 2026
summary: The Rotary Club of Hermanus invites you to gather under the stars for Hermanus Carols, with the Zwelihle Youth Choir, a Nativity Play and carols. Funds raised support Rotary projects.
description:
This festive season, the Rotary Club of Hermanus invites you to gather under the stars for Hermanus Carols a joyful celebration in our beautiful town.

· Children are invited to meet Father Christmas (don’t forget to bring a present with your child’s name on it!)

·Experience the powerful voices, vibrant energy and rich African rhythms of Hermanus’s Zwelihle Youth Choir in a captivating performance filled with uplifting harmonies.

· Be moved by the Nativity Play, led by Bass Baritone Corniël Calitz and well known Hermanus singers · Sing along with the choir to heartwarming carols under the night sky

· Grab a hearty snack from the local food stalls or bring your own picnic basket and blanket and settle in for an evening of festive cheer.

All funds raised will support Rotary projects, including Early Childhood Development and the Bursary Fund for the Overstrand Learning Hub.

Gates open 18:00 with pre-carols entertainment starting at 18:30, and the Nativity Play, 19:30 – 20:45

Bring your picnic basket with drinks, snacks, and a blanket

Children 6 and below Free

summary: An outdoor picnic concert at Harold Porter National Botanical Garden in Betty's Bay with saxophonist Andrew Young, featuring Tony Drake on keyboards.
description:
Spend a glorious summer evening surrounded by the spectacular natural beauty of Harold Porter National Botanical Garden in Bettys’ Bay, with award-winning international saxophonist Andrew Young, featuring Tony Drake on keyboards.
Set against the magnificent backdrop of the Kogelberg mountains and indigenous fynbos, this special outdoor picnic concert is the perfect way to enjoy the festive season with family and friends.
From the timeless music of The Beatles and unforgettable movie themes to soul, rock, rhythm & blues and much-loved favourites, Andrew brings his unmistakable sound, exceptional musicianship, infectious energy, warmth and humour to the stage.
